entry_conditions: Observed state is near a demonstrated approach, pull, release or departure phase: drawer state, TCP-to-drawer relation and fingers are compatible; small tracking or switch-induced TCP deviations are acceptable when IK is feasible.
exit_conditions: Drawer is approximately 0.300 m open and stable, fingers are open, TCP has retreated safely and is moving toward/above the observed block, which remains undisturbed.
overlap_role: All actions 300:440 are supervised in every trajectory, allowing this fresh-state correction policy or retrieve_tunnel_block to own post-release retreat, turn and early descent.
successor_readiness: Switch after stable full opening, handle release and arm clearance. The framework must retain the two causal frames over the switch.
failure_signatures: Increasing drawer/TCP error, open stop not reached, high drawer velocity, fingers inconsistent with phase, disturbed block, or IK residual/limit contact. Do not infer handle contact solely from closed fingers.
continuation_guidance: Continue while local corrections stay near demonstrated scale and causal phase cues agree. Prefer drawer-frame or dual-anchor policies for large anchor displacement, and stop rather than claim recovery if the handle was missed.
limitations: Guidance does not alter task success. Local corrections provide no demonstrated recovery guarantee and may be unsafe or unreachable when errors are large or phase order is unseen.
